subject: TipTap content node schema: @naadi/shared/content (extension set, zod doc schema, converter)
body: # TipTap content schema (S05 importer <-> S06 renderer): one extension set in `@naadi/shared/content` Owner: seg05-seed (packages/shared/src/content/**). Consumers: S06 ContentRenderer, later the admin editor and the assistant's chapter-edit tool. TipTap 3.34.0 (`@tiptap/core`, `@tiptap/pm`, `@tiptap/starter-kit`, `@tiptap/extension-table`, `@tiptap/extension-subscript`, `@tiptap/extension-superscript`, `@tiptap/html` + `happy-dom` for the Node-side converter) become deps of packages/shared. ## Exports (`import { ... } from "@naadi/shared/content"`) - `contentExtensions`: the ONLY schema extension set (StarterKit trimmed to the nodes/marks below + our custom nodes). An editor adds editor-only extensions (undo, dropcursor, placeholder) that do not change the schema. - `CONTENT_NODE_TYPES`, `CONTENT_MARK_TYPES` (readonly tuples; a test fails if they drift from the extension set). - zod `ContentDocSchema` (+ types `ContentDoc`, `ContentNode`, `ContentMark`, per-node attr types). Strict: an unknown node/mark type fails `safeParse`, so the renderer can show its "unknown node" card naming the offending type. - `htmlToContentDoc(html)` (server side: importer, admin HTML paste) -> `{ doc, figureIds, readingMinutes }`; throws `ContentConversionError` on any unknown tag/class/attribute, leftover `[[figure:`, or text lost in conversion. ## Nodes (TipTap JSON `type` / attrs / content / source HTML) | type | attrs | content | source HTML | |---|---|---|---| | `doc` | - | `block+` | | | `paragraph` | - | `inline*` | `p` (bare text in cells/list items/callouts is wrapped in a paragraph) | | `heading` | `level: 2 \| 3 \| 4` | `inline*` | `h2..h4` (seed uses `h3`; the section title is `chapter_sections.heading`, not in the body) | | `bulletList` / `orderedList` | orderedList: `start: number` (default 1), `type: string \| null` | `listItem+` | `ul` / `ol` | | `listItem` | - | `paragraph block*` | `li` | | `table` | `highYield: boolean` (default false) | `tableRow+` | `table` (`class="hy"` -> true; all 537 seed tables have it) | | `tableRow` | - | `(tableCell \| tableHeader)*` | `tr` (thead/tbody dissolve, header cells are tableHeader) | | `tableHeader` / `tableCell` | `colspan: number = 1`, `rowspan: number = 1`, `colwidth: number[] \| null` | `block+` | `th` / `td` | | `callout` | `variant: "pearl" \| "trap" \| "bridge"` | `block+` | `div.pearl` / `div.trap` / `div.bridge` | | `figure` | `mediaId: string` (= `media_assets.id`, e.g. `ch01-fig01`) | atom | `[[figure:ID]]` -> `
